item.title: What’s Cool in School: Salamanca students advocate on Capitol Hill - Salamanca Free Press
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Students from Salamanca High School’s Civics Engagement Program gained firsthand experience in advocacy and leadership earlier this week in Washington, DC. As part of their ongoing commitment to civic participation, the students met with policymakers to advocate for Federal Impact Aid, an essential funding source that supports schools serving federally connected students.
